name: burst-session
description: Claude Burst inside the session: route, real context, a context bar (/context-bar) and compaction above the prompt, standing aside where the usage sidebar shows them (/burst band puts it back), the usage panel's summary in /burst, Burst's alerts and compaction lines as toasts, /compact-async-full, which compacts with the summary Burst already wrote, /burst-dump, which lists everything in the context Burst last sent (what the cache holds), /burst-prune, which takes out of it what a word names, and /claude-burst-revert and /claude-burst-reinstall, which work with the gateway down
